item.text:
**3B.1 Research Note: Ali Khamenei in 2024**

**Bottom line:** the 2024 record is strongly negative. I found repeated evidence of executions, torture, coerced confessions, and continued political imprisonment. The only real positive evidence is a set of periodic clemency decrees for some inmates, but those were limited, discretionary, and explicitly excluded many security-related offenses. That is not the same as protecting residents from state violence.

| Title | Publisher | Date | Recoverable URL | Claim-level summary | Question IDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|
| `Iran: Executions of protester with mental disability and Kurdish man mark plunge into new realms of cruelty` | Amnesty International | 2024-01-24 | [link](https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/01/iran-executions-of-protester-with-mental-disability-and-kurdish-man-mark-plunge-into-new-realms-of-cruelty/) | Iran executed Mohammad Ghobadlou and Farhad Salimi after grossly unfair, secrecy-shrouded processes. This is direct evidence of arbitrary and exemplary punishment rather than protection from state violence. | `3B.1` |
| `Iran: Security Forces Rape, Torture, Detainees` | Human Rights Watch | 2024-04-22 | [link](https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/04/22/iran-security-forces-rape-torture-detainees) | HRW documented rape, torture, and sexual assault of detainees during the crackdown on protests, including coercion into false confessions. This is strong evidence of state violence and torture against residents. | `3B.1` |
| `Iran executes 853 people in eight-year high amid relentless repression and renewed ‘war on drugs’` | Amnesty International | 2024-04-04 | [link](https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/04/iran-executes-853-people-in-eight-year-high-amid-relentless-repression-and-renewed-war-on-drugs/) | Amnesty reported an execution surge, including mass use of the death penalty for drug offenses after unfair Revolutionary Court trials. This supports a pattern of political fear and arbitrary killing, not resident protection. | `3B.1` |
| `Iran dissident group says six members sentenced to death` | Reuters | 2024-12-04 | [link](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/iran-dissident-group-says-six-members-sentenced-to-death-3754608) | Reuters reported six dissidents sentenced to death for opposition-related charges amid a new wave of death sentences. This shows continuing political imprisonment and capital punishment against dissent. | `3B.1` |
| `Ayatollah Khamenei pardons, commutes sentences of over 2,000 prisoners` | Press TV | 2024-04-06 | [link](https://www.presstv.ir/Detail/2024/04/06/723171/-Supreme-Leader-Ayatollah-Khamenei-pardons-commutes-sentences-of-over-2%2C000-Iranian-inmates) | Khamenei approved pardons or commutations for 2,127 inmates for Eid/Nowruz. This is a limited positive signal, but it was discretionary clemency, not a broad rights safeguard, and it excluded armed struggle and other serious offenses. | `3B.1` |
| `Leader pardons, commutes sentences of 2,654 inmates over upcoming eids` | Press TV | 2024-06-16 | [link](https://www.presstv.ir/Detail/2024/06/16/727571/Iran-Khamenei-Eid-al-Adha-Ghadir-Celebrations-Prisoner-Pardon) | Khamenei approved pardons or commutations for 2,654 inmates, including some security-related cases and minors. This is the clearest positive evidence I found, but it is still partial clemency rather than systemic protection from political imprisonment. | `3B.1` |
| `Leader approves pardoning, commuting sentences of about 3,000 Iranian convicts` | Press TV | 2024-09-20 | [link](https://www.presstv.ir/Detail/2024/09/20/733636/Leader-approves-pardoning-convicts) | Khamenei approved pardons or commutations for nearly 3,000 convicts, including some security-related cases. Again, this shows occasional sentence reduction, but not a documented curb on torture, arbitrary detention, or extrajudicial abuse. | `3B.1` |

**Assessment**

- **Positive evidence:** periodic clemency decrees for selected prisoners.
- **Negative evidence:** torture, rape, coercive confessions, unfair trials, and executions remain the dominant pattern in 2024.
- **Net reading:** Khamenei did **not** protect residents from state violence in any robust sense in 2024.

**Search gap**

- I did **not** find reliable 2024 evidence that Khamenei ordered accountability for torture, arbitrary detention, disappearances, or extrajudicial killing.
- I also did **not** find evidence of a general policy change that would materially reduce political imprisonment or exemplary punishment. The only protective signals were narrow clemency gestures.
